newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI says FII investment at $78.8 mln in '97.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI says FII investment at $78.8 mln in '97.

text.p: Foreign institutional investment (FII) in Indian bourses stood at $78.8 million during the period from January 1 to January 24 this year, the Securities & Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Thursday.
SEBI said net investments by registered foreign investors had touched $7.32 billion to date.
India opened its doors to foreign portfolio investments in 1993.
